author: Arnav
problem: Read a string S of lowercase letters and a string T of 3 uppercase letters. T is an airport code for S if it is a length-3 subsequence of S in uppercase, or a length-2 subsequence of S in uppercase followed by 'X'. Print Yes if T is an airport code for S, otherwise No.
bug_description: Treats reaching the end of S as no match, so a code whose last letter matches the last character of S gets No.

comments.accurate: Greedily matches T (minus a trailing X) as a subsequence of S, ignoring case
comments.wrong_behavior: Greedily matches T (minus a trailing X) as a subsequence of S; the match has to finish before the scan reaches the end of S
comments.wrong_location: Subsequence scan verified; check the trailing X is only dropped when it's the third letter

source.fixed_line: if j == len(S) and S[-1] != T[-1]:
